title: Transport from a derived pullback monoidal model
statement: For a morphism g and a derived pullback core monoidal model m satisfying IsDerivedPullbackMonoidalModel g m, there exists a family τ satisfying IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g τ.

proof.text: Identify the model module functor with tensorPullback by functor extensionality. Compare its left-derived counit with the shared counit by Functor.leftDerivedUnique. Conjugate the inverse model tensorator by the inverse comparison on the tensor input and by the tensor of the forward comparisons on the outputs. The model summand equation and its pinned inverse tensorator prove the degreewise equation. Naturality of the comparison, the counit factorization, tensor composition and cancellation of the model tensorator prove the coordinate equation. Functor.Monoidal.transport supplies naturality in both inputs. All steps are formalized; the elementary categorical manipulations are factored into proved private helpers.

proof_origin.note: Reuse the existing complete adopted-source implementation of the same proof route. Restore the old Sheaf path by public import and private import all. Checked definitional equality of all three definitions, and availability of existence, model transport, uniqueness and the private helper API to an import-all consumer. No proof dependency or unit route is removed.
